user_query: I'm organizing a company team-building event and we need to find a suitable venue. Can you suggest some event spaces or conference centers in our city? Please provide their addresses, website links, and contact information. Thank you!

TaskList.description: Gather a list of event spaces or conference centers in the specified city.
For each venue retrieved in Subtask 1, collect their address, website link, and contact information.
Compile all the gathered information into a structured format (e.g., table or report) for easy sharing.
